environments.description: Per-environment configuration. Required for semver-per-env and calver-per-env strategies.

forges.description: Code-hosting platforms heraut talks to (ADR-0043/ADR-0044): connection/identity only. What to publish (draft/assets) lives in release.targets; the enrichment source is commits.enrichment_forge.

Commits.description: Single source of truth for commit semantics and enrichment (ADR-0033): the conventional-commit type set (used by 'heraut commit verify'/'create' and the native renderer), scope rules, ticket links, and the enrichment_policy.

types_heading_level.description: Heading depth (number of '#') for type sections in rendered output. Defaults to the renderer's default when omitted.

types.description: Conventional-commit type rules, merged over the built-in defaults by name. The effective set is both the 'heraut commit verify' allow-list and the changelog section taxonomy.

scopes.description: Allowed scopes. Offered by 'heraut commit create'; enforced by 'heraut commit verify' only when scopes_restricted is true.

scopes_restricted.description: When true, 'heraut commit verify' rejects scopes outside the scopes list. Defaults to false.

tickets.description: Issue-tracker links. Each entry's regex is matched in commit messages and rendered as a link in the changelog and release notes.

pattern.description: Regex matching ticket IDs, e.g. [A-Z]+-[0-9]+. The first capture group (or full match) becomes {ticket}.

enrichment_forge.description: References a forges[].name used as the PR/MR metadata source for changelog and release-notes generation (ADR-0043).

enrichment_policy.description: PR/MR enrichment policy sourced from enrichment_forge: 'required': fetch and fail if unavailable. 'optional' (default): fetch when possible, else warn. 'disabled': never fetch. The --offline flag forces 'disabled' for a single run. Renamed from remote_metadata (removed, ADR-0043).

TypeRule.description: One conventional-commit type rule, merged over the built-in defaults by name.

name.description: The conventional-commit type word (e.g. feat, fix).

order.description: Display sort position for the changelog section. Omit for unordered (sorts after ordered types).

render.description: Section heading label (e.g. "🚀 Features"). Omit to route the type into the catch-all "💼 Other" group (like the default build type).

remove.description: Drop this default type from the effective set (removes it from the 'heraut commit verify' allow-list).

description.description: One-line hint shown beside the type in the 'heraut commit create' wizard picker.

ScopeRule.description: One allowed commit scope. 'description' is shown in the commit wizard picker; 'remove' drops a built-in default scope.

remove.description: Drop this scope from the effective set — used to remove a built-in default (deps, deps-dev, release).

description.description: One-line hint shown beside the scope in the 'heraut commit create' wizard picker.

excludes.description: Filters that drop matched commits from the rendered changelog/release-notes.

templates.description: Override built-in native template blocks. Each value is a Go text/template snippet. native only; deep-merged global -> per-driver -> per-env (ADR-0037).

header.description: Version heading line. Changelog default: '## [version](compare-url) - date'. Release-notes default: empty.

commit.description: One commit line: description, scope, breaking marker, hash link, 'by @author', PR/MR reference, ticket links.

ticket.description: One ticket link within a commit line (called once per match from the commit block). Default: '([TICKET](url))'.

contributor.description: One entry in the New Contributors block for a first-time contributor.

contributors.description: The 'New Contributors ❤️' block wrapping the contributor entries (release notes).

stats.description: The Commit Statistics block (commit/issue counts, timespan) in release notes.

footer.description: Trailing content appended after the body. Empty by default.

changelog.description: Root changelog-section template composing header, group, and commit blocks.

release-notes.description: Root release-notes template composing header, group, commit, contributors, and stats blocks.

Exclude.description: Drops matched commits from rendered output. Set exactly one of type or regex.

type.description: Match commits of this conventional-commit type.

regex.description: Match commits whose subject matches this regex (e.g. "^chore\\(deps").

tag_prefix.description: Tag prefix (e.g. "v"). Set to "" for bare version tags.

initial_version.description: Version used when no tags exist yet. SemVer strategies only.

bump.description: Bump mode. "auto" infers from conventional commits. SemVer strategies only.

format.description: CalVer format string (e.g. "YYYY.MM.PATCH"). Required for calver strategies.

sprint.description: Current sprint counter. Required when format contains SPRINT. Advance with heraut version sprint bump.

tag_format.description: Common tag format template for per-env strategies (e.g. "{env}/{version}").

tag_type.description: Git tag type. "annotated" (default) creates tags with a tagger, timestamp, and message. "lightweight" creates bare ref tags.

commit_message.description: Commit message template for the changelog commit, and (when tag_type is "annotated") the tag's own annotation message. "${version}" is substituted with the resolved version. Defaults to "chore(release): ${version}".

output.description: Changelog output file path (e.g. "CHANGELOG.md"). For changelog.output only (not release.notes.output, which is never written to disk): may contain rotation tokens for a periodic file, e.g. "CHANGELOG_{YYYY}.md" (calver: YYYY, MM, DD, WW, QQ, SS, SPRINT) or "CHANGELOG_{MAJOR}.md" (semver: MAJOR, MINOR). See docs/specs/02-configuration.md § Rotating changelog output.

tag_pattern.description: Regex selecting this scope's release tags, applied in-process (Go regex). E.g. "^v[0-9]" for bare semver or "^prod/" for a per-env prefix.

template.description: Path to a full template file (Go text/template) parsed on top of the built-in blocks: it may redefine the document root and/or any block; parsed last, so it wins over inline rendering.templates for whatever it defines (ADR-0037).

rendering.description: Per-driver rendering overrides (template snippets + excludes), deep-merged over the global rendering block (ADR-0037).

assets.description: Glob patterns for files to attach to the release, applied to all targets. Globs are expanded at release time; a pattern matching nothing emits a warning but does not abort the release. If a target also defines assets, the target-level list takes full precedence for that target (no merging).

targets.description: Release publish destinations, each referencing a forges[].name (ADR-0043/ADR-0044).

Forge.description: One code-hosting platform heraut talks to — connection/identity only (ADR-0043/ADR-0044). What to publish (draft/assets) lives in release.targets; the enrichment source is commits.enrichment_forge.

name.description: Unique identifier for this forge entry, referenced by release.targets[].forge and commits.enrichment_forge.

project.description: GitLab project path (namespace[/subgroup]/repo). GitLab. For azure_devops, "organization/project".

repository.description: GitHub repository (owner/repo). GitHub. For azure_devops, the repository name.

base_url.description: Web base URL of the forge instance (e.g. https://gitlab.example.com for a self-hosted instance). Defaults per type when unset.

api_url.description: API host override, when it differs from base_url. Defaults per type when unset.

token_env.description: Environment variable holding the API token. Defaults per type when unset.

Target.description: One release publish destination: a reference to a forges[].name plus publish options (ADR-0043).

forge.description: References a forges[].name. Optional when exactly one forge is configured.

assets.description: Target-specific glob patterns for files to attach to the release. When set, overrides release.assets entirely for this target. Omit to inherit release.assets.

EnvRelease.description: Per-environment release overrides. Absent fields inherit from root release.

notes.description: Override release notes generator for this environment.

targets.description: Override release publish targets for this environment (ADR-0043/ADR-0044).

Environment.description: Per-environment configuration. Versioning fields drive version resolution; content fields override changelog/release.

branch.description: Branch this environment is operated from. heraut refuses any --env command for this environment unless the current git branch matches (override with --force).

source.description: Source environment for promote bump mode.

disable_changelog.description: Disable changelog generation for this environment.

disable_release.description: Disable the entire release: behavior (notes generation and publishing, together) for this environment.

changelog.description: Override changelog generator for this environment.

release.description: Override release settings for this environment.
